customerTransfer.title: Customer transfer
customerTransfer.description: Export one or more customers as a self-contained ZIP package and import it into another installation. The package contains customer data, service history, reports, documents and files.
customerTransfer.warningText: The package may contain contact details, site addresses, service history, reports, HSE/health information, documents and attachments. Treat it as confidential, keep access restricted and delete it after transfer. Passwords, hashes, 2FA secrets, sessions and API keys are never included.

export.title: Export customer
export.description: Select customers and package contents. The export is kept for 24 hours and can only be downloaded by you.
export.searchPlaceholder: Name, customer number or organisation number
export.signaturesWarning: Signature images may be personal data with an unresolved legal basis. The PDF is the primary visual record. Enable only after a documented assessment.
export.piiConfirm: I understand that the package contains personal data and must be handled confidentially.
export.reused: Reused the recent export with the same customers and options.

import.title: Import customer
import.description: Upload a customer package. The package is validated and previewed before anything is written. Confirmation writes all rows and files in one transaction.
import.createMissingReferences: Create missing departments, tags and categories
import.createMissingReferencesHelp: Staff and templates are never created. Without this option missing references become null with a warning, or the import is blocked when the reference is required.
import.policyHelp: The default is to skip duplicates. Update is only allowed for safe customer and equipment fields. Reports are never updated.
import.confirmLabel: I understand that the import writes data to the database, creates files and may create disabled portal users.
import.cannotImport: Import is blocked until the errors above are fixed.
import.cleanupNote: Temporary files have been deleted. The import is recorded in the audit log.
